title: Quality
text: Quality. The picture of it doesn't do it justice. The colors are beautiful. What I did find was that the measurements were a bit off. It said 23" by 48" Mine measured 28" by 53" Which is fine. More to love.

product_metadata.title: DaDa Bedding Autumn Banquet Tapestry - Blooming French Countryside Floral Needle Stitched Woven Wall Hanging - Bordered with Rod Pocket Loops
features: Beautifully hand-crafted woven wall hanging décor made with durable cotton and polyester material to give extra thickness in longevity. Lovely accent piece in any room for that artistic baroque décor!
Attached on top of wall hanging tapestry are three loops for extra support through curtain poles or pinned onto wall for easy hanging
Wall Hanging Dimensions - 28" W x 43" L
Material - Face: 45% Cotton 55% Polyester, Back: 35% Cotton 65% Polyester
Washing Care Instructions: Wash under 40°c, Do Not Bleach, Dry Clean, No Iron, Do Not Tumble Dry - Line dry to protect from heat.
